units.source_text: 岛村心想：已经这么冷了吗？

en.t: Shimamura wondered, had it already grown this cold?

units.source_text: 他向窗外望去，只见铁路人员当作临时宿舍的木板房，

en.t: He looked out the window and saw the plank huts that the railway workers used as temporary lodging,

units.source_text: 星星点点地散落在山脚下，给人一种冷寂的感觉。

en.t: scattered here and there at the foot of the mountain, giving everything a cold and desolate feeling.

units.source_text: 那边的白雪，早已被黑暗吞噬了。

en.t: The white snow over there had long since been swallowed by the darkness.
